scope: Scoring implementation notes frozen after Phase A collection and before training or H1. No change to L1-L6 thresholds, model inputs, structural endpoint or control permissions.

frame_population.source: Score every registered ECM exposure in each stream and depth variant. Join the HD twin to its main frame by episode and tick. No filtering by visibility, grip, successful task completion or proximity to the endpoint; auxiliary views are not scored.
frame_population.sheet_present: The paired main NPZ has both label_nodes and label_cut_length. A valid sheet-present 0 mm label counts as class 0. Do not infer sheet presence from cut length, RGB-D appearance or trace length. A partial label pair, malformed label or missing frame is a data-integrity failure, not an abstention.
frame_population.pre_sheet: If neither label is present, there is no structural ordinal. Include these frames as negative exposures for L1: any 9 or 10 prediction is a false endpoint. Report their frame count, abstention count, and non-endpoint numeric count separately. Exclude them from ordinal coverage, L2, L3, L4 and L6 denominators. Do not treat a hidden but present sheet as pre-sheet.
frame_population.zero_denominator: A rate with no denominator is undefined, never zero or a pass; a gate requiring that rate is not evaluable and cannot pass. Report numerator and denominator, and report coverage at each exact true length (especially 8 and 9) beside L4.

metadata_baseline.features: Cumulative accepted CUT closures through this exposure, and the sampled advance_m cap for that episode. Count an accepted close even if structural growth is zero. No target length, actual motion distance, tick, simulator geometry, cut length, scenario, view, FSM state or image enters the classifier.
metadata_baseline.phase_a_count: Reconstruct from label_grip in the contiguous main-frame sequence: start with 0 closures at the first (pre-sheet) observation, then increment once on a same-episode 0.5 rad -> 0.0 rad transition (absolute tolerance 1e-6 rad for commanded values). Repeated open/closed snapshots do not increment. Start open is allowed but is not itself a closing action. Refuse missing/non-finite grip, off-command angles or missing ticks; never estimate count using cut growth.
metadata_baseline.future_count: Before H1 collection, log accepted SimWorld.close_scissors returns in the collector, without changing motion or adding a simulation step. Save the cumulative count at exposure for metadata scoring only. Verify agreement of direct count and grip reconstruction on a fresh paired development audit, including refusal/recovery paths, before using Phase A proxies to fit the formal baseline. H1 must carry a valid explicit count; a missing count is an integrity failure, not a skipped L6 example.
metadata_baseline.fit: Use sheet-present actual ECM frames from the frozen development training episodes, not validation, auxiliary, H1 or H2. Use one entry per episode/tick (do not double count HD or noise copies). For each (closure_count, advance_um) pair predict the most frequent exact structural row, where advance_um = round(advance_m * 1000000). Tie: smaller row. For an unseen pair use the mode pooled over caps at the same count; if the count is unseen, use the global training mode. No abstention for the metadata classifier. Freeze its fitted tables before H1.
metadata_baseline.L6: Compare the frozen visual and metadata predictions on the identical H1 true 9/10 mm exposures from non-default advance caps (advance_um != 3000). Keep the registered strict greater-than comparison, separately for each scored stream and its prescribed depth variants. Also report baseline false endpoints and exact-row accuracy; high recall alone does not make it safe.

phase_a_pilot.purpose: Check the development loader and one CUDA train/validation pass at 640x480, not to fit a ranked or frozen H1 candidate. No L1-L6 decision, calibration, holdout or controller use.
phase_a_pilot.split: Use dev indices 0-299 only. Lexically order episodes by SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string learned_perception_v1/phase_a_partition/<index>; first 30 are validation, remaining 270 are training. Use the first 68 of those 270 for the single-epoch smoke run. No frame or other view of an episode goes to the other partition.
phase_a_pilot.inputs: Pilot uses only actual 640x480 ECM RGB-D, full resolution, clean depth. RGB divided by 255; depth clipped to [0, far] in metres. Reject non-finite depth. Metadata and labels are never feature channels. HD/aux are retained, not used for this pilot.
phase_a_pilot.recipe: One epoch, ResNet-18 from scratch (four input channels, 14 length logits), AdamW lr 0.0003, weight_decay 0.01, batch 8, seed 20261123, bf16 autocast on CUDA. For sheet-present samples use cross-entropy on the exact row. For pre-sheet samples use a uniform 14-class target, not a synthetic 0 mm label. Log separate counts and mean loss per partition; do not tune or report threshold-based predictions from this pilot.
